items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Cecil Erwin was on tenor, as you mentioned, and Omer Simeon was lead alto

ctx.x: He was one of the first trumpet players I remember there.
Cecil Erwin was on tenor, as you mentioned, and Omer Simeon was lead alto, and what a band that was. And then Jimmy Mundy came in later.
